name: upload-post
description: Publish, schedule and grow on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Discord, Telegram, Mastodon, WordPress and Google Business via the Upload-Post API.
author: Upload-Post

interface.longDescription: Operate social media from your agent — not just talk about it. Post video/photo/text to 15 platforms in one call, schedule content, run Instagram comment-to-DM funnels, repurpose long video into shorts/reels, turn any URL into a viral carousel, and track analytics. Pairs with the Upload-Post MCP connector (OAuth) so no API keys live in prompts.
